1.o: يواجه القبطان فلينت تمردًا من طاقمه، بينما ينضم جون سيلفر إلى السفينة وهو يخفي شيئًا ذا قيمة كبيرة. وعلى جزيرة نيو بروفيدنس، تحاول إليانور غوثري الحفاظ على النظام مع ازدياد تهديد البحرية الملكية.

2.o: يكشف فلينت هوية اللص الموجود بين أفراد طاقمه، بينما يطارد راكهام غنيمة رغم اعتراض فين. ويختبئ سيلفر مع ماكس في بيت للدعارة، فيما تواجه إليانور خيارًا صعبًا.

3.o: يبحث فلينت وغيتس عن شريك لمساعدتهما في مطاردة سفينة أوركا دي ليما، بينما يحاول سيلفر مساعدة بيلي في حل مشكلة داخل الطاقم. وفي الوقت نفسه، يحاول فين إقناع إليانور بتغيير موقفها منه.

4.o: تواجه سفينة والروس كارثة أثناء إحدى عملياتها، ويحذر سيلفر فلينت من بيلي. ويحاول راكهام وبوني استعادة مصدر رزقهما، بينما تحتاج إليانور إلى مساعدة والدها.

5.o: يخوض فلينت وطاقم والروس مواجهة بحرية خطيرة ضد القبطان برايسون وسفينة أندروماتشي للحصول على شحنة ثمينة، بينما يجبر ريتشارد ابنته إليانور على اتخاذ قرار بشأن أعماله.

6.o: تستمر الخسائر الناتجة عن مطاردة أندروماتشي، وتحتاج إليانور إلى مساعدة سيلفر. ويحاول بيلي إقناع غيتس بمواجهة فلينت، بينما تتخذ بوني موقفًا حاسمًا.

7.o: يكشف فلينت لغيتس الحقيقة، بينما يضع راندال سيلفر في مأزق. وتتلقى إليانور ضربة مؤلمة، في حين تساعد ماكس راكهام، ويجد فين نفسه في مواجهة خطيرة.

8.o: يقدم سيلفر لفلينت التفاصيل الأخيرة عن موعد وموقع السفينة، لكن وضع إليانور يتغير بعد غرق سفن الإمدادات في الخليج. وفي الوقت نفسه، يتصاعد التمرد على متن والروس، ويضطر غيتس إلى اتخاذ قرار حاسم.

1.o: يواجه فلينت وسيلفر حكم طاقمهما بعد انكشاف جرائمهما، بينما يستمتع فين بمكانته الجديدة في الجزيرة، وتواجه ماكس بوني، وتظهر لإلينور تهديدات جديدة.

2.o: يقدم فلينت نصيحة لدوفريسن، بينما يحاول سيلفر إثبات أهميته للطاقم. وتُطلب من إلينور شهادة ضد أحد القباطنة، في حين يبدأ راكهام بتوسيع طموحاته.

3.o: يعود فلينت إلى ناسو ليجد نفسه أمام مأزق جديد، وتلجأ إلينور إلى مصدر غير متوقع للمساعدة، بينما يحاول راكهام استعادة سمعته ويكتشف فين غنيمة غير متوقعة.

4.o: يهدد فلينت فين، وتضطر إلينور إلى اختيار جانبها، بينما يكتشف راكهام قدرات ماكس الحقيقية، ويلتقي سيلفر بصديق قديم.

5.o: تنطلق ميراندا في رحلة لإنقاذ الجزيرة، بينما تستعيد إلينور جراحًا قديمة، ويبدأ راكهام في البحث عن سر كبير.

6.o: تحاول إلينور التوسط لإحلال السلام، لكن راكهام يتعلم بالطريقة الصعبة، بينما يخلف فلينت وعدًا قطعه وتفقد بوني السيطرة على الوضع.

7.o: تحاول ماكس تنظيف آثار مجزرة، بينما تغير تطورات جديدة كل شيء بالنسبة إلى فلينت وسيلفر، وتخاطر إلينور بحياتها من أجل مستقبلها.

8.o: يستعد فلينت وميراندا للأسوأ، بينما يكتشف سيلفر حقيقة تغير نظرته للأمور، وتكتشف إلينور سر ماكس، ويتخذ فين خطوته الحاسمة.

9.o: يواجه فلينت وميراندا ماضيهما، وتعلن بوني نواياها لراكهام، بينما يستولي فين على غنيمة ضخمة وتعلن إلينور الحرب.

10.o: يحصل فلينت على مساعدة من حليف غير متوقع، بينما يرغب طاقم فين في تغيير الوضع، ويقدم سيلفر تضحية كبيرة.

1.o: يشن فلينت وطاقمه حربًا ضد كل من يقف في طريق القراصنة، بينما تحصل إليانور على عرض بالعفو، ويعترض فين على أساليب راكهام.

2.o: يواجه طاقم والروس قسوة البحر، بينما يختلف تيتش وراكهام، وتضع إليانور وروجرز شروط شراكتهما، وتشعر بوني بالقلق على مستقبل علاقتها بماكس.

3.o: يدفع فلينت سيلفر إلى أقصى حدوده، بينما تستعد ناسو لصد الغزو. ويتولى راكهام القيادة، وتحاول ماكس ترتيب أوضاعها، فيما يضطر فين لاتخاذ قرار صعب.

4.o: تعود مظاهر الحضارة إلى ناسو، بينما يواجه فلينت وسيلفر وبيلي عدوًا جديدًا، ويتخذ راكهام موقفًا ضد طاقمه.

5.o: يواجه سيلفر خطر الموت ويدفع فلينت إلى التحرك، بينما يرشد تيتش فين إلى طريق جديد، ويظهر تهديد جديد يضع إليانور وروجرز في خطر.

6.o: يصطدم فلينت وتيتش حول مستقبل القرصنة، بينما يُجري روجرز اعتقالًا، ويجد راكهام هدفًا جديدًا، وتحاول مادي مساعدة سيلفر.

7.o: يعود فلينت وسيلفر إلى ناسو، فتولد أسطورة جديدة. وفي الوقت نفسه، يهدد تغير الشروط راكهام وبوني، وتتغير مهمة فين.

8.o: يتعرض روجرز لهجوم أثناء نقل أحد السجناء، ويندلع العنف على متن والروس، بينما يخضع سيلفر ومادي لاختبار صعب.

9.o: تخاطر إليانور بكل شيء لإنقاذ روجرز، بينما يبحث بيلي عن حلفاء، ويواجه فين الحكم، ويستعد فلينت وسيلفر للحرب.

10.o: تنطلق قوات روجرز لمطاردة القراصنة، ويواجه راكهام وبوني ظروفًا تبدو مستحيلة، بينما يطالب سيلفر فلينت بإجابات ويتوج بيلي ملكًا.

1.o: تنتهي محاولة استعادة ناسو بكارثة، بينما يسعى تيتش وراكهام للانتقام لمقتل تشارلز فين، وتحاول إليانور التأقلم مع دورها الجديد.

2.o: يخضع فلينت لسلطة بيلي، بينما تضع إليانور خطة لإنقاذ روجرز، ويُجبر سيلفر على تولي قيادة الحرب لاستعادة ناسو.

3.o: تواجه ماكس مشكلة مع القانون، ويواجه روجرز ماضيه، بينما يتوصل فلينت ومادي إلى تفاهم، ويعود جون سيلفر إلى الواجهة.

4.o: تعم الفوضى والعنف شوارع ناسو، ويطالب سيلفر بيلي بإجابات، بينما تحاول إليانور مساعدة ماكس، ويواجه راكهام وبوني محنة قاسية.

5.o: يصبح مصير فلينت في يد سيلفر، بينما يزيد بيلي الانقسام بين القراصنة، وتخاطر إليانور بكل شيء لتحقيق النصر، ويقدم روجرز عرضًا مفاجئًا.

6.o: تصبح ناسو تحت سيطرة جديدة، ويحاول سيلفر إصلاح ما أفسده، بينما ينفصل فلينت عن مادي ويبحث روجرز عن إليانور.

7.o: يحذر فلينت سيلفر من التهور، وتقود ماكس راكهام وبوني إلى داخل الجزيرة، بينما يعثر بيلي على أحد الناجين ويكتشف روجرز حقيقة مهمة.

8.o: تهدد خطة إنقاذ بانقسام فلينت وسيلفر، وتكتشف ماكس الثمن الحقيقي للحرية، بينما يطارد راكهام هدفه ويدخل طاقم والروس منطقة مجهولة.

9.o: يبحر سيلفر ورجاله إلى جزيرة الهيكل العظمي بحثًا عن فلينت، بينما تتلقى مادي عرضًا، ويواجه روجرز صعوبة في الوصول إلى إليانور، ويتخذ بيلي موقفه النهائي.

10.o: يشن فلينت هجومه الأخير لإسقاط نفوذ إنجلترا، ويتخذ سيلفر قرارًا لا رجعة فيه، بينما يواجه راكهام روجرز وتتغير ناسو إلى الأبد.

1.o: When tightly wound Capt. Holt takes over the precinct, carefree Det. Jake Peralta and his dysfunctional coworkers' lives get demanding.

2.o: Jake is assigned a lowly graffiti case as punishment for being late to roll call.

3.o: Jake's unsolved cases pile up and the other detectives fear that his losing streak will rub off on them, while Amy must run an at-risk youth program.

4.o: The team turns on Jake for delaying an autopsy report by flirting with an attractive medical examiner, who turns out to be more than he bargained for.

5.o: A Major Crimes detective known as "The Vulture" takes over Jake's nearly solved case and steals his thunder, prompting revenge.

6.o: Halloween-hating Amy is anything but festive when she has to don a costume and hit the streets with Charles on busy Halloween night.

7.o: After making an arrest with too little proof, Jake has 48 hours to get evidence or the perp will go free, forcing the team to work over the weekend.

8.o: Jake's dream day with his hero, a former crime reporter, turns nightmarish when his comments about Holt and the precinct go "on the record."

9.o: When Jake's favorite pizzeria is burned down and the fire marshal suspects the owner, Jake steps outside his jurisdiction to catch the real arsonist.

10.o: Amy hosts Thanksgiving dinner for the precinct in an effort to get Holt to be her mentor, but Holt and Jake leave early and the rest hate her cooking.

11.o: When Capt. Holt receives death threats, Jake is placed on his protective detail and revels in the chance to boss his boss around.

12.o: Jake and Rosa hunt an infamous car thief, Holt tries to find a home for puppies and the rest of the precinct tries to accommodate a wounded Charles.

13.o: After Jake and Amy's bet about who can make more arrests is finally settled, the two go on a stakeout where Jake reevaluates their relationship.

14.o: On his first task back in the field, Terry takes advice from Jake on controlling his emotions to infiltrate and bust a steroid trafficking ring.

15.o: While investigating a string of hotel robberies together, Jake discovers that Amy may transfer to the Major Crimes unit and work with "The Vulture."

16.o: At Capt. Holt's birthday party, Jake, Amy and the other officers try to make a good impression on Holt's husband but fail miserably.

17.o: To stop Detective Boyle from getting too clingy, or "Full Boyle," with his new girlfriend, Jake goes on their date, but things don't go as planned.

18.o: When Jake's building goes co-op and he must pay nearly a half million dollars to keep his apartment, he desperately seeks Gina's help.

19.o: At Tactical Village, where the precinct competes against other precincts in paintball exercises, Jake gets jealous when Amy runs into an old flame.

20.o: When Charles makes Jake his best man, it means cake tasting, choosing flowers and convincing fiancée Vivian that Charles doesn't want to move.

21.o: On a solving streak, Jake decides to spend his weekend off with Sgt. Terry trying to crack a cold case that no one thinks can be solved.

22.o: Jake risks suspension when the commissioner shuts down his investigation of a civic leader and he gets Amy and Holt to help him work the case anyway.

1.o: When Jake discovers that a mobster escaped his otherwise successful sting, he enlists Charles to help track him down, which worries Gina.

2.o: Holt's nemesis heads the precinct inspection, while Terry readies for his vasectomy and Charles needs a date for his ex-wife's engagement party.

3.o: When a motorcade detail is delayed, it leads to a wacky competition, and Charles must get an incriminating videotape from Hitchcock.

4.o: For their annual Halloween wager, Jake bets Holt that he can steal his watch before midnight, and Gina gets kicked off her dance squad, Floorgasm.

5.o: Holt and Jake search for a mole in the precinct, and Terry and Rosa visit a silent disco to find "Giggle Pig" dealers.

6.o: Jake is attracted to a woman he soon discovers is the attorney for a perp he's after, and Rosa gets Amy to run for union rep to replace Scully.

7.o: When the precinct goes into lockdown on Thanksgiving night, it's up to Jake to keep morale high, even as things spiral out of control.

8.o: To catch a drug dealer, Jake and Charles must team up with an incompetent Postal Service investigator. Meanwhile, the team helps Amy quit smoking.

9.o: When Jake and Amy have to stay overnight at a hotel for a case, Jake invites Sophia and Amy's boyfriend Teddy over, but the move backfires.

10.o: Jake and Rosa catch the Pontiac Bandit, who could lead them to the Giggle Pig kingpin. Charles and Gina worry about their parents getting close.

11.o: Jake and Charles go on a stakeout that lasts way too long, and Terry writes a book for his daughters that angers Amy and Gina.

12.o: Jake ruins the precinct's annual beach house getaway when he's pressured into bringing Captain Holt. Gina wants to see "six-drink Amy."

13.o: Jake has to go to great lengths to keep a secret about Terry from the rest of the precinct, and Amy finally gets to partner up with Captain Holt.

14.o: When his relationship with Sophia gets in the way of her work, Jake tries to help, Wuntch needs Holt's help, and Charles wants Gina's blessing.

15.o: The Nine-Nine is invited to a terrorist training drill with Homeland Security, but the precinct's role as hostages doesn't go over so well.

16.o: Jake is determined to prove that he's not to blame for Holt's bad mood, and when Charles catches a notorious bank robber, nobody believes him.

17.o: It's wedding day for Charles and Gina's parents, and everyone in the squad is given duties; but Jake and Gina get distracted, and Terry has troubles.

18.o: When Jake's absentee father visits, Charles suspects he's up to no good. Holt throws down a brain twister challenge.

19.o: Holt makes Amy and Rosa investigate Jake's bad luck, but he also insults Gina. Charles partners with Hitchcock and Scully.

20.o: Terry forces Jake to take time off after he's injured chasing a perp, and Holt and Rosa go on an awkward double date with their significant others.

21.o: Jake gets jealous over another detective's romantic interest in Amy, and Terry is tempted to accept a job at a private security firm.

22.o: Holt worries Jake is being set up to fail when Wuntch green lights his dream assignment, and Terry hosts a field trip for a magnet school.

23.o: Jake and Amy go undercover to catch an infamous identity thief, and the squad is rocked by an unexpected farewell.

1.o: The precinct's new captain makes an unforgettable first impression. Jake and Amy try to keep their budding romance under wraps.

2.o: Another shakeup at the precinct spells trouble for Jake and Amy, while a string of disappointments sends Holt into a downward spiral.

3.o: A smitten Boyle vows to get a fellow foodie out of prison by proving her innocence. Holt's bid to boost cops' public image sparks a backlash.

4.o: While Jake and Holt secretly team up to hunt for a serial killer, Amy and Rosa seek revenge for a sexist assignment.

5.o: For their annual Halloween heist, Jake and Holt draft teams and compete to steal a crown. But Amy's divided loyalties leave her out in the cold.

6.o: Jake and Charles whisk Terry away for an ill-fated camping trip, while Holt helps Rosa with a dilemma, and Amy tries to cash in on an old invention.

7.o: A lovers' spat leads to trouble on the job as Jake and Amy chase down a new street drug. A parking mishap drives a wedge between Holt and Boyle.

8.o: Jake jumps into action when Terry's wife goes into labor at the precinct. Meanwhile, an Internet outage forces the team to go old-school.

9.o: Tensions flare as Jake and Rosa work a case with two peculiar Swedish cops. Neil deGrasse Tyson drops by to help Gina prepare for a big test.

10.o: A last-minute Christmas shopping trip lands Jake, Gina and Charles in the middle of a "Die Hard"-like hostage crisis.

11.o: Boyle tries to recover some sensitive cargo held hostage by his ruthless ex-wife. Amy injures Terry at the worst possible moment.

12.o: An illness leaves Jake and Holt quarantined and delusional as they try to solve a cold case. Terry discovers running the precinct is messy work.

13.o: Jake and Amy embark on a romantic cruise, only to find an old adversary aboard. Holt braces for a visit from his melodramatic sister.

14.o: Amy gears up to meet Jake's mother on his birthday, but the celebration takes an unexpected turn. New body cameras prove embarrassing for Boyle.

15.o: Sparks fly when a neighboring precinct moves in with the Nine-Nine. Jake's reunion with an old partner yields an unhappy surprise.

16.o: Jake persuades Scully and Hitchcock to take over a drug bust so he can help out with a "celebrity" matter. But neither case is what the team expected.

17.o: A cop fresh off an undercover stint with the mob has trouble readjusting to precinct life. Boyle's culinary exploits trigger a janitorial standoff.

18.o: Jake and Amy volunteer to house-sit for Holt, with disastrous results. The chemistry between Rosa and Pimento heats up.

19.o: An adorable special delivery reminds Terry of an unsolved case that's haunted him for years. With Jake's help, he sets out to finally crack it.

20.o: A whirlwind engagement sends the gang scrambling to throw twin bachelor and bachelorette parties. But the night of revelry takes an unexpected turn.

21.o: To root out the crooked FBI agent who targeted Pimento, the team stages an elaborate fake funeral and sends Amy on a risky undercover mission.

22.o: With help from an old friend of Holt's, the gang sneaks into the FBI to find dirt on the double agent. An inmate puts Charles in an awkward position.

23.o: Jake and the team scour the hospital for a captive Captain Holt, while Amy and Charles book it back to New York to help their friends.

1.o: Jake and Holt continue their new lives in Florida under the Witness Protection Program while Jimmy remains at large, but their identities may be revealed after a video of the pair goes viral.

2.o: Jake and Holt end up on the other side of the interrogation table after being caught plotting an attack on Figgis. Meanwhile, a questionable new captain takes over at the precinct.

3.o: The team makes a road trip to Florida to try to help Jake and Holt take down Figgis. With an unforeseen injury and yet another interruption by Sheriff Reynolds, the plan doesn’t follow through quite like they all had hoped. In the midst of the chaos, Jake and Amy share an awkward reunion.

4.o:
As Jake struggles with his first case back at the precinct, he encounters Jess Day, who is visiting New York, and enlists her to help him find his suspect. Meanwhile, Holt researches ways to increase office morale and Amy tries to figure out why Rosa keeps taking such long breaks.

The crossover continues on New Girl S06E04 Homecoming (II).

5.o: It’s Halloween in the Nine-Nine, which can only mean one thing: heist time. This year, the squad members pull out all the stops in their quest to win the new defending title of “Ultimate Detective Slash Genius.” Lines are drawn and plans are made, but there can only be one reigning champion.

6.o: Pimento and Rosa decide to pick up where they left off and get married, so the whole squad preps a perfect wedding under Amy’s careful direction. Pimento enlists Jake and Gina to hunt for his grandmother’s ruby earrings for Rosa to wear in the ceremony, but the universe has other plans for them.

7.o: At Amy's intricately planned Thanksgiving dinner, Jake goes "full Santiago" (binder and all) in order to impress her father, a former cop. With Jake and Amy's focus elsewhere, Charles is left on turkey duty and Holt helps Pimento cope after learning he can no longer work for the NYPD.

8.o: When famous author DC Parlov receives death threats, Jake and Terry take the case, so that Terry can meet his lifelong hero. Back at the precinct, Gina forces her way into the Boyle clan of cousins in an attempt to choose the location of the annual Boyle family vacation. Meanwhile, Holt's anger peaks when Amy chooses Kevin's side in their argument about a math puzzle.

9.o: Captain "CJ" is having major problems with a big case, and Jake and Holt find the motivation to help him out. Inside the precinct, war ensues when Terry enforces a green initiative and tells Gina to get rid of her precious space heater, while Rosa and Boyle take a break from the night shift to visit a foot massage parlor.

10.o: Charles enlists Jake's help in tracking down his son's favorite toy for Christmas, and the two find themselves accidentally facing off against a Latvian criminal ring as a result. Back at the precinct, the team gears up for their annual Christmas carol competition against their sworn enemy: the MTA.

11.o: When a prison-van escape sets nine convicts loose in the city, Jake and Amy compete to see who can bring in the most fugitives.

12.o: The effort to capture prison escapees continues. Jake teams up with an unlikely ally who's related to one of the convicts.

13.o: Due to low crime rates, Brooklyn decides to close one of its precincts. The future of the Nine-Nine depends on an audit conducted by Amy’s boring ex.

14.o: Jake and Rosa tackle a case of a missing laptop on the set of a long-running TV police procedural. Terry’s vengeful ex takes over the audit.

15.o: The squad learns it's dangerously close to being shut down. Jake and Charles go out on one last case that quickly escalates into a major drug bust.

16.o: After getting stopped and mistreated by an unfamiliar cop, Terry receives some disappointing advice from Holt about how to handle the profiling.

17.o: Eager to blow off steam, the squad tries to keep Holt in the dark as they throw a secret party during a police convention in upstate New York.

18.o: Jake and Rosa go on a search mission after a stressed-out Amy disappears on the day of her sergeant's exam. Gina inherits a Boyle family heirloom.

19.o: While looking into a break-in at Holt's mother's house, Jake discovers a secret she’s been keeping from her son. The squad remodels the break room.

20.o: A drug case leads Jake and Rosa to an investigation conducted by their shared idol, Lt. Hawkins, who indicates she may have a job for one of them.

21.o: Jake and Rosa call for backup from Holt and Pimento after their search for bank robbers turns dangerous. Boyle disapproves of Gina's new boyfriend.

22.o: When Jake and Rosa find themselves framed for a crime they didn't commit, the squad must cook up an exceptionally creative solution.

1.o: Stuck behind bars, Jake lands in trouble over some delicious contraband. Fellow inmate Rosa keeps Holt and Terry busy with a never-ending to-do list.

2.o: As the squad looks for ways to implicate the corrupt Lt. Hawkins, Jake puts his detective skills to work with help from his affable cannibal cellmate.

3.o: Freed from prison and back on duty, Jake hunts for a sneaker thief under Holt's watchful eye. Meanwhile, Rosa suspects Pimento of infidelity.

4.o: Jake pulls off a major surprise during the squad's annual Halloween heist, a cutthroat competition to claim the coveted title of Amazing Human/Genius.

5.o: An undercover operation brings out Holt's inner gambler. Rosa tries to out-laze Hitchcock and Scully. Charles buys a food truck with an unsavory past.

6.o: Nemeses plague the squad, as Jake and Amy's big day gets derailed by the Vulture, and Charles must find his missing equine foe, Sgt. Peanut Butter.

7.o: On Thanksgiving, alcohol provides a temporary fix to Jake and Amy's parental problems, and a pilfered pie awakens the ruthless interrogator in Holt.

8.o: Jake and Terry go undercover at a costume-packed fan convention when their favorite fantasy author reports his much-anticipated manuscript stolen.

9.o: After missing their flight home from a funeral in LA, Jake and the squad scramble to get Holt back to New York in time for a big interview.

10.o: Intensely private Rosa shares personal news with the team but wants Jake's help to tell her parents. Cyber Crimes steals the Nine-Nine's bandwidth.

11.o: Crime boss Seamus Murphy resurfaces to claim his promised favor from Holt, so Jake and Charles befriend the Murphy family's Fredo to get information.

12.o: After a threat from Murphy, Holt stashes husband Kevin in a safe house with Jake. Rosa goes undercover at a salon. Scully reveals an actual skill.

13.o: Tapped to negotiate a hostage situation, Jake realizes the perp is someone he knows. Meanwhile, tensions flare inside Charles's meatball food truck.

14.o: As Jake begins an intense interrogation of a wily dentist suspected of murder, an opera-bound Holt jumps in to assist. Sterling K. Brown guest-stars.

14.o: Angel struggles with his jealousy of the Groosalugg and Cordelia's attraction to him; Gunn and Fred get captured by a tree monster.

1.o: As Fred and Gunn search for Angel, Wesley continues his affair with Lilah and conducts his own, more fruitful, search.

2.o: In his quest to steal an artifact that may help him find Cordelia, Angel finds himself competing with a human thief whose body is electrically charged.

3.o: Angel and his friends discover that Lorne is being held prisoner in a corrupt Las Vegas casino.

4.o: After Cordelia returns, she doesn't remember her friends and Lorne senses a major evil brewing. Scared by the world of demons and vampires, Cordelia takes refuge with Connor, who saves her from a demon attack.

5.o: Fred discovers her old physics professor is the one who exiled her to Pylea; Cordelia can't get comfortable with Connor and begins to wonder more about her history with Angel.

6.o: Lorne's spell to restore Cordelia's memory backfires and convinces everyone they're high school students who have been gathered to kill a vampire: Angel.

7.o: As plagues of various pests descend on Los Angeles, the beast Cordelia saw in her vision returns - and the apocalypse begins.

8.o: Connor gets locked inside Wolfram and Hart with the Big Bad doomsday beast, who turns the legal firms staff into an army of zombies.

9.o: After a group of totems linked to the ancient sun god Ra are killed by the Big Bad beast, Angel and his friends realize he's plotting to turn off the sun.

15.o: As Faith and Angelus lay drugged and possibly dying, they flash back to key events in Angel's life... and Willow comes to help the others in the quest to restore Angel's soul.

18.o: While everyone else worships the beautiful woman Cordelia bore, Fred sees another side of her.

19.o: As Jasmine's influence continues to spread, Fred finally tricks Angel into seeing her true nature.

20.o: While hiding in a sewer, Angel and his friends battle a nasty monster provides some clues that might help in the larger battle against Jasmine.

21.o: Angel returns from the monster's dimension and finally defuses Jasmine's all-compassing powers.

2.o: Angel and Spike challenge a necromancer who is unhappy with Wolfram and Hart's new leadership.

3.o: Angel tries to help a young woman who has been turned into a werewolf and is being pursued by a group of truly rarified gourmets.

4.o: After being menaced by a series of gruesome ghosts no one else can see, Spike finally comes face to face with the spectral being who's been trying to drag him into hell.

19.o: As Angel and Hamilton urge Wesley to get rid of Illyria, she suffers a cataclysmic physical breakdown; and Gunn clashes with Angel over the enforcement of an evil demon contract.

1.o: Hong Joo's dreams always come true. She dreams of hugging a man whom she has never met and is shocked at her actions. On the night of Valentine's Day, she is worried about her mom and hurries home to see her.

2.o: Jae Chan has a dream about Hong Joo. He feels that he must prevent the events of his dreams from actually happening and tries his best to make sure that the accident never happens.

3.t: The Good, The Bad, The Weird (1)
3.o: Jae Chan finds out that Hong Joo has precognitive dreams on a regular basis and visits her after dreaming of his younger brother, Seung Won, becoming a murderer.

4.t: The Good, The Bad, The Weird (2)
4.o: So Yoon tries to kill her father to protect her mother, and Seung Won tries to stop her and help her out.

5.o: Jae Chan and Hong Joo meet before the situation becomes irreversible. Before things get ugly, Jae Chan gets to Seung Won, and Hong Joo improvises so that things turn out differently from her dream.

6.o: Jae Chan tells Seung Won to stay out of trouble, but they only drift apart more.

7.o: Woo Tak has a precognitive dream that shows Hong Joo getting injured. He brings Jae Chan along to where it actually happens, so Jae Chan is able to prevent the injury from happening.

8.o: Woo Tak and Hong Joo have similar dreams, but they end in different conclusions. They call Jae Chan in order to lead to the result they hope for.

9.o: Hong Joo is torn between going back to work and helping her mother out at the restaurant.

10.o: As Jae Chan, Woo Tak and Hong Joo begin to alter the future by preventing the events from happening, Hong Joo gains hope that perhaps her fate isn't sealed.

11.o: Jae Chan has a precognitive dream that shows Hong Joo announcing false insurance case in the news.

12.o: To prevent the case, Jae Chan asks Hong Joo to remember the details of incident if anything happens, so that he can find her after seeing in his precognitive dream.

13.o: Jae Chan arrives to the scene of the crime to find out Woo Tak has been stabbed. He goes after Dae Hee and manages to arrest him. Jae Chan works hard to make sure that Dae Hee is prosecuted for his crimes.

14.o: Meanwhile, Woo Tak stays at Hong Joo's house while he recovers and asks both Hong Joo and Jae Chan for favors while he's there.

15.o: A murder case of Yoo Su Kyung,a former professional archer, occurs andDo Hak Youngis pointed as the prime suspect.

16.o: Hak Young is a friend of Woo Tak, so Woo Tak convinces Hak Young to turn himself in. Jae Chan has to prosecute Hak Young, but there’s not enough evidence to do so.

17.o: Hak Young is released and set to be investigated without detention. Thanks to a comment left by a netizen, Hong Joo figures out the cause of the strange markings on the floor of Yoo Su Kyung's apartment.

18.o: Meanwhile, Yu Beom uses the media to appeal to the public on Yoo Su Kyung's case.

19.o: Jae Chan gets shot by Yoo Su Kyung’s father, Yoo Man Ho, and gets transferred to a hospital.

20.o: Hong Joo receives a note that Jae Chan sent to her before the accident and realizes that they’ve known each other for over 13 years.

21.t: To Die or to Be Bad (1)
21.o: Jae Chan is released from the hospital and stays with Hong Joo for two days. Woo Tak and Hong Joo both dream about Jae Chan. In their dream, Jae Chan is in charge of a case that results in his resignation from the prosecution.

22.t: To Die or to Be Bad (2)
22.o: Upon his return to work, Jae Chan must decide whether or not he will authorize the autopsy for a man who is set to donate his organs.

23.o: Jae Chan charges Moon Tae Min for murder despite everyone’s disapproval. He has to prove that Lee Hwan didn’t die from the organ transplant, but Yu Beom has a strong argument that Jae Chan can’t win over.

24.o: Meanwhile, Moon Sun wants to keep Jae Chan away from Hong Joo because she doesn’t want to see Hong Joo suffer.

25.t: We're on Our Way to Meet You Now (1)
25.o: Woo Tak and Jae Chan share their theory behind why they can see each other's future in their dreams.

26.t: We're on Our Way to Meet You Now (2)
26.o: Hong Joo goes to Criminal Division Three to follow a prosecutor for three days for an article, and Jae Chan is worried that he will embarrass himself in front of her. Meanwhile, a cellphone thief provides evidence for a past case.

27.o: After the arson, Criminal Division Three is swamped with work.

28.o: Woo Joo and Hee Min look into the arson case, and Ji Gwang and Jae Chan reinvestigate the IV drip serial murder case. Hong Joo also begins to look into the case. Meanwhile, Yu Beom receives a mysterious text message from the real killer.

29.o: Hong Joo is injected with a lethal drug and loses consciousness.

30.o: Fortunately, Jae Chan comes just in time to save her. The court hearing begins and Hong Joo is summoned to testify.

31.o: Yu Beom is on trial for manipulating the murder of Ha Ju Won. Before the trial, Dam Dong suspects that Yu Beom will try to leave the country. He tells Jae Chan, who tells Woo Joo that they must a travel ban preventing Yu Beom from leaving.

32.o: Meanwhile, Woo Tak decides to take a huge risk in order to help this trial be successful.

1.ar: صادفت الأمور أنّ جوش يقطن هنا
1.o: تدرك "ريبيكا"، رغم نجاحها، أنها ليست سعيدة في نيويورك، وتقرر ملاحقة صديقها الحميم السابق "جوش" إلى "ويست كوفينا" في كاليفورنيا.

2.o: تصادف "ريبيكا" صديقة "جوش" الحميمة، مدربة اليوغا الحسناء التي تُدعى "فالينسيا"، ويستحوذ عليها هاجس مصادقتها.

3.t: I Hope Josh Comes to My Party!
3.o: تواجه "ريبيكا" أحد مخاوف طفولتها حين تقنعها "بولا" باستضافة حفل استقبال في منزلها الجديد، وتغمرها السعادة عندما يوافق "جوش" على الحضور.

4.t: I'm Going on a Date With Josh's Friend!
4.o: تقرر "ريبيكا" اتخاذ قرارات أكثر عقلانية بعد أن أوشكت على ممارسة الجنس مع شاب قابلته على شبكة "تيندر" الاجتماعية، وتقرر مواعدة "غريغ".

5.t: Josh and I Are Good People!
5.o: بعد أن نعتهما "غريغ" بالشخصين السيئين، تحاول "ريبيكا" تحسين سمعتها عبر قيامها بأعمال الخير، بينما يذهب "جوش" إلى الكنيسة للاعتراف.

6.o: تتمكن "ريبيكا" من الحصول على دعوة لحضور عيد الشكر لدى عائلة "تشان"، حيث تروق لهم أكثر من "فالينسيا"، بينما يقدّم "غريغ" تضحية لوالده.

7.t: I'm So Happy That Josh Is So Happy!
7.o: تدخل "ريبيكا" في حالة كآبة وتنهار أثناء عرض توضيحي في العمل، بينما تغازل "بولا" العميل الوسيم الذي يحاولون كسبه.

8.t: My Mom, Greg’s Mom and Josh’s Sweet Dance Moves!
8.o: تستعد "ريبيكا" المتوترة لاستقبال والدتها كثيرة الانتقاد أثناء عطلة الأعياد، بينما يعاني "غريغ" من مشاكله العائلية الخاصة.

9.t: I'm Going to the Beach With Josh and His Friends!
9.o: تدعو "فالينسيا" "ريبيكا" لرحلة إلى الشاطئ، لكن "بولا" تحذرها وتخبرها بأنها فخ. وتستأجر "ريبيكا" باصًا للحفلات لتثير إعجاب المجموعة.

10.t: I'm Back at Camp With Josh!
10.o: تحاول "ريبيكا" الغارقة في الحب مرافقة "جوش" عندما تكتشف أنه تطوع للعمل في معسكر صيفي للمراهقين الفقراء.

11.t: That Text Was Not Meant for Josh!
11.o: ترسل "ريبيكا" دون قصد رسالة نصية إلى "جوش" تعترف في فحواها بحبها له، ثم تضطر لاقتحام بيته وحذفها قبل أن يصل إلى المنزل.

12.t: Josh and I Work on a Case!
12.o: تدبر "بولا" خطة محكمة لمساعدة "ريبيكا" في تلطيف الأجواء مع "جوش"، ويخوض "داريل" مناقشة غريبة مع "وايت جوش" في الصالة الرياضية.

13.t: Josh and I Go to Los Angeles!
13.o: تذهب "ريبيكا" بقضية "جوش" إلى المحكمة، حيث تواجه عدوتها اللدودة "أودرا"، ويدرك "غريغ" أنه لا يزال يكن مشاعر الحب لـ "ريبيكا".

14.o: يخبر "جوش" الذي يُثقله الشعور بالذنب "فالينسيا" بما حدث، ويحضر "داريل" إلى المكتب، وتكتشف "ريبيكا" أنها قد أفلست.

15.t: Josh Has No Idea Where I Am!
15.o: الجميع يبحث عن "ريبيكا" في "ويست كوفينا" وهي على متن طائرة متجهة إلى نيويورك حيث تحظى بجلسة علاج نفسية ماراثونية....مع أحلامها وهواجسها.

16.o: تتوطد علاقة "ريبيكا" و "فالينسيا" حين تطلب منهما شقيقة "جوش" أن تكونا إشبينتيها في زفافها، ويقرر "غريغ" أن الوقت قد حان للمضي قدمًا.

17.t: Why Is Josh in a Bad Mood?
17.o: تؤثر علاقة "ريبيكا" العابرة مع "غريغ" سلبًا على صداقتها مع "بولا" وتُسبب بعض التأثيرات الجسدية المزعجة.

18.t: Paula Needs to Get Over Josh!
18.o: تواجه "بولا" "ريبيكا"، ويوبخ "غريغ" "جوش"، وتصل الأمور إلى نهايتها عندما يجتمع الكل في حفل زفاف "جيما".

1.o: تحاول "بولا" إقناع "ريبيكا" بأن "جوش" لا همّ له سوى استغلالها. وفي الوقت نفسه، يشعر "جوش" في قرارة نفسه بالذنب لخيانته "غريغ".

2.t: When Will Josh See How Cool I am?
2.o: تُخبر "ريبيكا" "جوش" أنها بطلة في لعبة تنس الطاولة لقضاء وقت أطول معه، ويحمل "غريغ" أخبارًا للرفاق وتقدم "باولا" طلبًا لكلية الحقوق.

3.t: All Signs Point to Josh… Or is it Josh’s Friend?
3.o: تتطلّع "ريبيكا" الحائرة بين "جوش" و "غريغ" إلى إشارة من الكون... بينما يكافح كل من "بولا" و "غريغ" في اتخاذ قرارات مصيرية مؤثرة.

4.t: When Will Josh and His Friend Leave Me Alone?
4.o: تهرع "هيذر" لنجدة "ريبيكا" بعد تعرضها لحادث مؤسف، وتحاول "ريبيكا" إعادة بناء حياتها من جديد، بينما تجد "بولا" نفسها على مفترق طرق.

5.t: Why is Josh’s Ex-Girlfriend Eating Carbs?
5.o: حرصًا منها على توطيد علاقتها بـ "فالينسيا"، تصحبها "ريبيكا" إلى مركز علاج استشفائي، ويكتئب "جوش" من وحدته، وتتخذ "بولا" صديقًا جديدًا.

6.t: Who Needs Josh When You Have a Girl Group?
6.o: ترغب "ريبيكا" في انضمام "بولا" إلى فرقة الفتيات الخاصة بها مع "هيذر" و "فالينسيا"، بينما يحاول "ترينت" اختراق مجموعة أصدقاء "ريبيكا".

7.t: Who’s the Cool Girl Josh is Dating?

8.o: تساعد "بولا" "داريل" في اختيار متبرعة بالبويضات، وتحاول "ريبيكا" إصلاح علاقة "ناثانيال" بوالده، بينما يُطرد "جوش" من المنزل على يد والدته.

9.o: فيما تُفرغ "ريبيكا" طاقتها في حفل "فالينسيا" بالتخطيط لمشروع، يتوجّه "ناثانيل" إلى الملهى برفقة "وايت جوش"، ويحتاج "داريل" إلى المال بشدة.

9.o: تبدي "ريبيكا" اهتمامًا برجل جديد، ولكن الأمور لا تسير وفق خطّتها. أما "ناثانيال" فيصادق شخصًا جديدًا في النادي الرياضي، ويعود "داريل" لعمله.

13.o: رغم ما تواجهه من تحدّيات على الصعيد الشخصي، تساند "ريبيكا" "بولا" في وقت الشدّة... وتكشف قلوب "غريغ" و"جوش" و"ناثانيال" عمّا تخفيه.

1.o: Avinash and Abha’s idyllic life turns upside-down when their 6-year-old daughter Siya is kidnapped. From grizzlies hunting caribou in the Alaskan mountains to prairie dogs battling a tornado, find out what it takes to be an American hero.

2.o: The wetlands of the southeastern USA are a magical world where the boundary between land and water is blurred. Black bears must carry their tiny cubs through gator-infested swamps while dolphins hurl themselves onto land to hunt. Here, Florida panthers have fought their way back from extinction, with a little help from humans, while tiny mice work to protect our shoreline from deadly hurricanes.

3.o: The north of America is a world of rugged mountains, including Denali, the highest peak on the continent, and sweeping Arctic tundra. Up here, the wild heroes, from grizzly bears to musk oxen to beavers to bald eagles, must battle through the continent’s most brutal winter, lit only by the ethereal beauty of the northern lights. For those who can make it, a spectacular summer of plenty awaits.

4.o: The southwestern USA, the setting for some of the most famous desert landscapes on our planet, is a world of animal heroes who can overcome anything that’s thrown at them, from the baking desert to the mighty Pacific Ocean. Mountain lions patrol the Grand Canyon looking for mates, gray whales tackle the longest mammal migration on Earth, and hummingbird supermoms raise chicks in the blistering heat.

5.o: The heart of America experiences the biggest temperature swings and the wildest storms on the planet. Life here has to endure four seasons in a day — sometimes in an hour! A cast of all-American heroes, from bison to wolves, burrowing owls to bobcats, uses courage, strength and cunning to overcome the elements and make a living in this wild and beautiful land.

6.o: Across North America, a growing band of wildlife heroes are fighting to preserve our most iconic animals and wildest places. Whether the battle is to rewild the northern prairies, save our rarest big cat or restore an underwater forest, these champions are everyday people of all ages and from all walks of life, sharing one thing in common: They care enough to make a difference.
